scope: mT5 learned context notes -> conditioned English -> fixed own-English Singlish

verification.verification_method: Recomputed serialization hashes using shipped pure functions; no model inference. Runtime dependencies unavailable locally; no training rerun.

assessment_method: Assistant read all84 matched cases across four ordinary/ablation routes and34 oracle diagnostic rows, plus source-only notes and supervision/serialization code. Per-case notes for34 annotated diagnostics. Qualitative review, no independent human accuracy or numerical semantic score.
conclusion: The planner learned annotation format and changes reply behavior, but this pilot does not establish reliable contextual improvement. Planner facts/roles are often wrong; correct notes and source-only oracle notes are also sometimes ignored by reply decoder. Singlish meaning changes persist separately.
positive_findings: COCKTAIL-NATURAL-04 predicted route preserves borrow until tomorrow rather than borrow tomorrow.
USER-CALL-001 reply keeps caller direction and defers, but control also does this and purpose remains unanswered.
ITEM-E-009 proposed send after three respects supplied timing and is closer to request than control charger ownership question.
failure_categories: Planner corrupts amounts, time/day values, ownership and negation, and emits unrelated call/text rules.
Correct predicted notes do not enforce after-eight restriction or User bookshop location.
Gold-note diagnostics still fail timing, budget, location and purpose; planner alone is not the sole observed limitation.

Instruction-field echo in continued control1/84 and same-model no-notes7/84; zero in actual predicted-note English. Removing notes is distribution-shifted for explicit responder and is not a clean measure of helpfulness.
Frozen Singlish rewriting can reverse a correct English refusal, reverse lender/borrower, or alter uncertainty/question meaning.
limits: One seed; assistant-authored training notes and new targets, with related scenario families across splits.
All84 conversations are development material; 50old validation and14natural/user cases have been reused. No locked test read or independent human review.
Notes changed66English strings; sensitivity is not correctness. Lower annotation/reference CE is not contextual accuracy.
Explicit responder was trained with supplied notes; empty-note ablation is distribution-shifted. Oracle strings differ from learned predictions and are not guaranteed upper bounds.
Selected and final reply checkpoints are the same step300; final is not an independent replication.
Source/base preservation comes from completed-run attestations and frozen manifests; large model weights were not downloaded or freshly rehashed locally.
next_recommendation: Retain baseline and all snapshots. If another experiment is requested, first isolate source-fact extraction from reply use on a new frozen evaluation, with roles/times/amounts checked separately; compare additional training against a matched no-note control. No automatic retraining or promotion from this review.
